purpose: behavior matrix for the 38 servers without coverage in behavior-sweep-2026-10-10 (the run-210 completion of the 78-server behavior matrix); out-of-sample test of the skeptic-corrected correlations
note: 37 JSON rows; 1 target (Cloudflare 530 origin down) failed at transport — see *.err files; totals below are over probed rows

findings.resultType: absent on ALL 37 probed servers (27 explicit "absent — treated as complete per MRTR; observation, not compliance", 10 no stateless list parseable). Combined with behavior-sweep-2026-10-10 (resultType:complete on all 7 verified-modern servers), resultType emission co-occurs with modern-era implementation across the full 78-server cohort. STILL A CORRELATION, NOT A DISCRIMINATOR: same-SDK confound remains (the SDKs that implement discover also emit resultType), and the cohort pre-filters for discover-answering servers.
findings.origin_check: strict on 5/37 (all legacy-era servers) + 1 HTTP 530 (Cloudflare origin down). Cross-cohort total: 14/78 origin-strict, era-mixed — orthogonal to modern-era-ness (confirmed out-of-sample).
findings.removed_ping: 24/37 still answer ping (removed in 2026-07-28 spec) — consistent with legacy implementations; 4 answered -32600 (request-shape rejection, not method-absence).
findings.missing_version: 27/37 accepted version-less requests (assume-latest compliance reading holds out-of-sample; NO server in either cohort rejected a missing protocolVersion).
